BusinessDescription: Example Precision Machinery Co. manufactures industrial pumps, compressors and fluid-handling equipment for the food processing, chemical and energy industries. The Company operates through two segments: Equipment, which designs and builds pumps and compressor systems, and Aftermarket, which provides spare parts, repairs and field services.
